dish.title: Ecuadorian Locro de Papa: Potato Soup with Queso Fresco and Avocado
dish.description: Russet and Yukon Gold potatoes simmered with onion, garlic, cumin, and achiote until the russets collapse into a thick golden soup, enriched with milk and melting queso fresco, and topped with avocado, scallions, and cilantro.

recipe_version.title: Ecuadorian Locro de Papa: Potato Soup with Queso Fresco and Avocado
recipe_version.description: Russet and Yukon Gold potatoes simmered with onion, garlic, cumin, and achiote until the russets collapse into a thick golden soup, enriched with milk and melting queso fresco, and topped with avocado, scallions, and cilantro.

ingredients.name: ground achiote
ingredients.display_name: ground achiote (annatto) whose label lists annatto only

ingredients.name: queso fresco
ingredients.display_name: queso fresco made with microbial enzymes or vegetable rennet (no animal rennet on the label)

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Chop the onion, mince the garlic, and peel and cut both kinds of potato into 1-inch chunks, keeping them separate. Cube the queso fresco.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.body: Heat the oil in the 5.5-quart Dutch oven over medium, about 1 minute. Cook the onion until soft, about 5 minutes, then the garlic, cumin, and achiote for 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Add both potatoes, 5 cups water, and the salt to the 5.5-quart Dutch oven. Bring to a boil over high, about 8 minutes to come to a boil, then simmer briskly until the russets fall apart, about 20 minutes; dice the avocados, slice the scallions, and chop the cilantro meanwhile. Mash about half the potatoes against the pot so the soup thickens.

steps.title: Enrich
steps.body: Stir in the milk and simmer gently 5 minutes. Off the heat, stir in the queso fresco and let it soften for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Ladle into bowls and top with avocado, scallions, and cilantro.

coverage_contribution: Ecuador has no meal in the catalog; the only Andean soup is Colombian ajiaco with chicken. A vegetarian, easy soup dinner.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with colombian-ajiaco: a vegetarian cumin-achiote potato soup with melted cheese, not a chicken soup with guascas, corn, capers, and cream. Compared with white-bean-kale-soup: potatoes mashed into a thick golden base, not beans and greens. Compared with potato-leek-gratin: a soup with avocado, not a baked gratin.
not_duplicate_of: Not a potato-leek soup or vichyssoise: no leeks and not pureed smooth.
